applies_to: Shinko PCD-33A program controller with the C5 RS-485 option; manual printed No.PCD3CE1 2003.02 (file PCD3CE2).
summary: The PCD-33A is a 9-pattern, 9-step ramp/soak temperature controller. With the C5 option it speaks Shinko protocol or Modbus ASCII/RTU on RS-485, one 16-bit holding register per request. The map covers every pattern/step SV, time and wait flag, per-pattern wait, alarm and time-signal values, PID and alarm settings, run/stop and advance commands, PV, MV, current SV, running pattern/step and status.

addressing.note: Data items are printed as hex (0080H, 1110H) and go into the request unchanged, as the manual's RTU example frames show (PV read at 0080H). The RTU example reads pattern 1 step 1 SV at 1110H (CRC 80F3H checked).

source.title: Communication Instruction Manual PCD-33A (C5, SVTC)
source.pages: Command table pp. 12-15; RTU examples p. 11; specification p. 16

notes: Pattern/step addresses follow the manual's 1xx0H scheme: 1000H + pattern x 100H + step x 10H + item (SV 0, time 1, wait 2); per-pattern items are 1p13H-1p17H. The RTU example reads pattern 1 step 1 SV at 1110H.
Scaling high/low limit (002CH, 002DH) and decimal point place (002EH) are listed without a Shinko or Modbus command code in the table, so they are left out; set the decimal point on the keypad.
Function 03 reads one register and 06 writes one; the number of data is fixed at 1.
Values with a decimal point are sent as whole numbers. Units of PID times, step times and MV are not printed in the table.
A value changed over the bus does not drag related values with it (e.g. lowering SV high limit leaves step SVs as they were).

integration.summary: Select Modbus RTU (or ASCII) in Auxiliary function setting mode 1, set instrument number and speed, then read PV 0080H, current SV 0083H, running pattern/step 0085H and status 0086H; start and stop the program with 0042H.
integration.enable: Requires the C5 option. Choose the Modbus protocol, instrument number and speed in Auxiliary function setting mode 1 on the keypad.
quirks: Modbus is not available through Shinko's IF-300-C5 converter; use a generic RS-232C/RS-485 converter.
Slave address range 0-95; address 0 is broadcast (no reply).
setup: Speeds 2400, 4800, 9600 (default) or 19200 bps; data 7 or 8 bits, parity even/odd/none, 1 or 2 stop bits.
Do not add a terminator: the unit has built-in pull-up/pull-down resistors.
gotchas: Changing an alarm action type resets that alarm's values; send the type first.
Exception 17 (11H) means the item cannot be set in the present state; 18 (12H) means the keypad is in setting mode.
